summary: Arco now works only while it can reach the server. When the server is down it says "The server can't be reached" instead of reading the shared drive, and a sign-in the server no longer accepts asks you to sign in to the server again.
details: Saving data processing rules needs the server's Engine; it no longer saves another way when the Engine is not running.
Arco remembers which server this PC signed in to and refuses a different server at the same address.
Sign in again, beside that message in the status bar or on the server in use in the Server tab, signs this PC in with your Windows account; the next request uses it without a restart.
